apikey not Pass and call failed!

diagnosis: PatSnap API key rejected across all 3 auth header formats. Error codes 67200008 (apikey not Pass) and 67200202 (apikey auth error) both indicate authentication failure, NOT balance exhaustion. This is the same BLOCKED state observed for previous territories (#1 V21, #4 V6, #6 discovery). Key is either expired, revoked, or never provisioned.

comparison_to_prior_territories.T4_V6: BLOCKED — error 67200005 BALANCE_EXHAUSTED (after ~5 successful nested-search calls + 50 semantic-search calls)
comparison_to_prior_territories.T7_DISCOVERY: BLOCKED — error 67200008/67200202 apikey auth error (immediately, 0 successful calls, key not accepted at all)

remediation: Need new PatSnap API key with valid credentials. Per V1.1 §6.3, cannot declare NOT_FOUND_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH without PatSnap passage-level verification. Other 3 sources (Lens, Scopus, Google Patents) used to compensate.
security_note: PatSnap API key used INLINE only via env var. NOT persisted to disk, NOT written to worklog, NOT written to any committed file.
